svg.text: One of eight. Load path: plate → cradle → cell frame → cell centre → TPU foot → floor.
Cutaway through the two plate screws. Plate on top, floor at the bottom. Parts move along the dashed line.
down through the plate, blue threadlocker

Load cell, centre boss facing DOWN
frame presses up against the pocket ceiling;
wires lie on the bottom face
strap sits in its channel, dome in the dimple; CA

Only the TPU foot touches the floor.
The retainer must clear the floor. If it touches, it carries
load around the cell and the reading drops.
3 · From below (looking up at the retainer)
Line up the cradle notch, the retainer notch, and the cell's wires.
4 · Which way the notches point (plate L and R from above)
Cradles are under the plates. Every notch faces the centre enclosure, so the cables run inward.
